If you have encounter any problem or suggests, please let us a message on the forum. 

In-addition, the Launch discount is ending soon. You can save 20% for the Edge of Twilight base program, and Ultimate Collector's Edition for 30% discount.

Thank you for supporting. And we are doing our best to provide better game experiences.

notes.title: Ultimate Collector's Edition is ready
notes.content:
To reward our fans for their support and patience, we are offering an Ultimate Collector’s Edition of Edge of Twilight. This version contains the upcoming releases of the Edge of Twilight series! Get the rest of the Edge of Twilight story when you choose the Ultimate Collector’s Edition. 

In addition to the complete story, the Ultimate Collector’s Edition includes the original Edge of Twilight soundtrack, which contains selected tracks from the ambient, steampunkish music that fueled you through the game. This option is your best accompaniment if you’re planning to purchase Edge of Twilight – Return to Glory. A copy of the original music files (in OGG format) included in the package. You can play all tracks with your own favorite music player.

- Six additional chapters, adding 30+ hours gameplay to Edge of Twilight*
- New skills and weapons*
- New ultimate bosses*
- [b]Original soundtrack. Music performed by a professional string quartet. Soundtrack produced and recorded by the industry’s top audio studio and producers
- Bonus content, only available for this DLC[/b]

* Will automatic update to you when become available.

Current Track list: 
- Spoken Words 1
- On My Way
- Tainted Gemini
- Spoken Words 2
- Nexus
- Athern Swan
- Ether Provoker
- Spoken Words 3
- Battleworn Antihero
- Ruined Fanfare
- The Giant’s Duel
- Blood in the Night

Bonus track:
- Lithern Tears
- Someone Special

more track will be added to the list soon...

notes.title: Buy Edge of Twilight Now
notes.content:
Edge of Twilight is now FOR SALE and ON SALE. Yes, for you early birds, we are taking a whopping $3 off the retail price for Edge of Twilight – Return to Glory. “Only $3,” you say? Hey – that’s a 20% discount!

Why so cheap? Because this is only the first chapter is an epic story. If you want to get all the future releases as soon as they hit the market, grab the Ultimate Collector’s Edition along with Return to Glory.

No, there is not a package deal for both at the same time. Yes, the Ultimate Collector’s Edition is not yet on Steam. Yes, it will be on Steam soon.

Let me make it very clear so that no one sits around anxiously picking their nails or clawing their skin or whatever your nervous tick might be. If you want to play Edge of Twilight, grab Return to Glory now! You do not need to wait for the Ultimate Collector’s Edition so that you can save money – the Ultimate Collector’s Edition is an add-on, meaning it does not contain Return to Glory.

Buy Return to Glory now, while it’s on sale. Come back 24 hours later, hopefully having slept and not just killing Tainted Lithern all night, and buy the Ultimate Collector’s Edition, which will give you access to all the future episodes. In addition, we are throwing in a soundtrack to the game, included in the Ultimate Collector’s Edition.

So, in conclusion, an FAQ: 
Should you wait for the Ultimate Collector’s Edition before buying Return to Glory? 
No. The Ultimate Collector’s Edition does not include Return to Glory.

Should you be in a rush to buy Return to Glory?
Yes. The discount is for a limited time only.

Should you be in a rush to buy the Ultimate Collector’s Edition when it is released in 24 hours?
Yes. We are adding a limited-time 35% discount to this edition to compensate for getting it out later than Return to Glory.

notes.title: Edge of Twilight Arrives on Steam
notes.content:
We are here today to announce some important information about Edge of Twilight. 

Edge of Twilight will be release on steam on [b]Sep 28, 2016 @ 2:00pm PDT.[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/489070/

We have chosen to release it at the competitive price of 14.99USD. And to make it even better, we are offering a 20% discount at launch.

You can also purchase the Ultimate Collector's Edition (priced at $13.99 and with a 35% discount at launch), which we highly recommended for players who want access to the future Edge of Twilight updates. Also included in the Ultimate Collector’s Edition is the Edge of Twilight soundtrack. You can enjoy the music from the game and listen to a separate collecting of sound files in the high-quality OGG format. Most importantly, the Ultimate Collector’s Edition is the only DLC allowing you to freely download all future updates, including the exclusive followup stories and bonus content only available for fans who purchased Ultimate Collector’s Edition. We highly recommend you purchase it along with Edge of Twilight - Return to Glory.

An alternative for players only interested at the main story line: the Edge of Twilight - Saga Complete DLC will become available later this year. Priced at $11.99, it only focus on the main story. More information will be announced later.

Once again, thank you very much of your support for all these years. It has been a long journey for Edge of Twilight. It is unfortunate that we are unable to provide you the complete story at the launch, but the entire story will be slowly revealed to players. As we explained previously, we have to release each chapter separately so that we can afford to pay the license fees and costs necessary to allow the game’s release to the public. This is our concern from here on out…

…for now, today on Sept 28, we just want you to enjoy the game.
